entries.title: Trepang2
entries.definitive_edition: Trepang2 Digital Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Digital Deluxe Edition / current PC release with DLC
primary.why: Trepang2 is available on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S, with the official Deluxe/Season Pass DLC available across the same modern platforms; Windows PC remains the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Trepang2 on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or the Xbox PC store for Windows PC; use the Digital Deluxe Edition or add the Season Pass/Bladekisser DLC for the most complete route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Deluxe/Season Pass DLC available.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity capture route and complete DLC path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 console release with Deluxe/DLC route available.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S release with Deluxe/DLC route available.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The official Deluxe/Season Pass DLC path is documented for PC and consoles, so the PC fidelity pick does not sacrifice exclusive content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Digital Deluxe/Season Pass content is DLC, not a remaster. Xbox Play Anywhere/Game Pass availability is a storefront/access route, not a separate version.
